task:
REVISE THE F4 DESIGN DOC FOR SIX ROUND-7 CODEX REVIEW FINDINGS (PR #801). Target branch codex/run-38015883683-1, expected head 22e59b0; fail closed and write nothing if it moved. Only docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-10-v3-finder-f4-archetype-ui-design.md may change. Verify claims against the code (cite file:line). Extend 'Review dispositions' with a round-7 list. Keep edits tight — this is the final design round; implementation-level refinements beyond these go to the F4a/F4b PRs.

P1 (~line 577, 'Separate shared selection from the detail-overlay trigger'): writing system=<id64> for every selection makes AppShell.svelte (~27-30) open SystemOverlay (modal, takes focus) and closing it clears the selection. FIX: introduce a distinct shareable selection parameter (e.g. `selected=<id64>`) that hydrates Explore selection and the Babylon marker WITHOUT opening the overlay; keep `system=<id64>` exclusively as the overlay/Inspect trigger; selection and overlay are decoupled; update the URL contract table, share-link E2E (clean session restores marker via `selected`), and the select → rerank/page → marker-retained journey.

P2-A (~line 695, 'Use SvelteKit navigation for URL replacement'): stale-offset correction must use `goto(url, { replaceState: true })` from `$app/navigation` (as AppShell.svelte does), never native history.replaceState, so page.url (the hydration source) and Back/Forward stay consistent.

P2-B (~line 1285, 'Preserve measured zero-distance comparisons'): buildCompareRows (compare-metrics.ts:164-167) treats 0 as the legacy no-reference sentinel; require that referenced snapshots accept finite distances including 0, only legacy snapshots without a reference are unknown; add a zero-distance regression to F4c.

P2-C (~line 514, 'Clamp galaxy-wide Any pages at the advertised cap'): for saturated unanchored Any searches clamp offset+page_size to the 10,000 cap (correct URLs beyond it) while anchored Any totals beyond 10,000 remain exact; cite local_db_search_v3's LIMIT/OFFSET and count cap behaviour.

P2-D (~line 1271, 'Make reference-safe comparison precede visible F4'): either move reference-aware comparison into F4a/F4b, or make F4c a hard prerequisite for enabling the flag, or suppress the distance metric in compare until F4c lands — choose one (recommend: suppress cross-reference distance comparison in F4b and ship the full behaviour in F4c, with F4c required before the flag is turned on) and state it in the PR plan and enablement question.

P2-E (~line 542, 'Avoid attributing every 503 to unpublished data'): archetypes.py (~380-390) returns 503 for ordinary PostgresError too; use generic temporary-unavailability copy unless the API exposes a stable machine-readable readiness reason; add that readiness reason as an optional slice-1 API nicety (not a prerequisite) and define the two copies.

Validation: git diff --name-only origin/main lists only the design doc; Markdown renders. Commit message: 'docs(finder): F4 design — round 7 review (selection param, SvelteKit navigation, zero distance, Any cap clamp, comparison ordering, 503 copy)'.
